an3.6:1.1: “Bhikkhus, one who possesses three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.6:1.3: Unwholesome bodily action, unwholesome verbal action, and unwholesome mental action.
an3.6:1.4: One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.6:2.1: “One who possesses three qualities should be known as a wise person.
an3.6:2.3: Wholesome bodily action, wholesome verbal action, and wholesome mental action.
an3.6:2.4: One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a wise person.
an3.6:2.5: “Therefore … It is in this way that you should train yourselves.”
